summary: Completed a repository-grounded architecture assessment for a future Survey/Questionnaire Acquisition lane and KU2A SEM support. No survey runtime, provider connector, analysis implementation, UI, production integration, or live request was added.

current_state.ku2a_dataset_intake: The current browser-first KU2A path imports CSV/XLSX or pasted tabular data, profiles fields and measurement levels locally, and sends a CSV analytical matrix to FastAPI only after explicit analysis execution.
current_state.ku2a_backend: The stateless FastAPI backend accepts one uploaded CSV plus reviewed intent, target, mode, and options. It has validated fast analytical routes but no survey design, response collection, or SEM route.
current_state.ku2d_public_acquisition: The existing KU2D lifecycle is optimized for public official Internet sources: Discover, Explore, Deep Audit, Human Approve, Scheduled Acquire, Monitor, and Re-Explore on drift.
current_state.existing_handoff_precedent: The reviewed YouTube knowledge-dataset contract demonstrates a non-production, provenance-rich KU2D-to-KU2A handoff, but survey responses require stronger privacy, consent, instrument-version, and sampling metadata.

placement_decision.logical_owner: KU2D should own survey specification, provider orchestration, collection status, response provenance, and acquisition-quality checks as a distinct user-authorized acquisition lane.
placement_decision.physical_boundary: A future survey-acquisition service or clearly isolated KU2D survey package should sit beside public Web acquisition rather than entering the public monitoring registry, public observation store, or scheduled source crawler.
placement_decision.response_storage: Identifiable or row-level survey responses belong in a privacy-controlled response store with study-scoped access and retention. They must not enter Learning Memory, Agent Handoff records, the public acquisition repository, or source-ranking evidence.
placement_decision.ku2a_boundary: KU2A should receive a frozen, versioned Analytical Dataset Handoff containing response data plus the survey metadata manifest. Uploaded survey CSV/XLSX may enter through current dataset intake, but SEM-aware or quality-aware analysis requires the companion manifest.
placement_decision.governance: Publishing a form is a Human Approve boundary distinct from provider connection, draft generation, collection, dataset handoff, and analytical-model approval.

acquisition_lanes.entry: User-authorized business/research system export or connector
acquisition_lanes.control_model: Connector-specific delegated access, schema mapping, provenance, revocation, and explicit dataset handoff

acquisition_lanes.entry: Question bank, Questionnaire Specification, or research/business question
acquisition_lanes.control_model: Design, Human Review, provider draft, Human Publish Approve, collect, monitor, freeze/export, quality review, KU2A handoff

staged_workflow.behavior: Import a simple Excel/CSV question bank into a draft Questionnaire Specification. Validate columns, stable item IDs, answer types, scale coding, and missing construct metadata; do not publish.
Add constructs, scale definitions, sampling intent, consent/privacy metadata, branching, required/optional status, language, and planned analysis. Suggestions remain non-authoritative.
A human reviews research purpose, appropriateness, wording, ordering, burden, consent, sampling, measurement validity, provider capability loss, and final publish preview.
Create a provider draft through a generic provider adapter. Publishing requires a separate explicit approval reference tied to the exact instrument version.
Show invitation/respondent counts, completion and dropout, collection window, quota/strata coverage, provider health, last synchronization, and warnings without treating response volume as quality.
Freeze a collection snapshot, preserve provider/export provenance, pseudonymize respondent identity, map item IDs to columns, and compute transparent quality diagnostics.
Send a versioned response table and metadata manifest to KU2A. Preserve the unmodified raw export separately from reviewed derived scale scores.

Future reviewed automation may produce descriptive response summaries, item distributions, missingness, reliability candidates, and analysis recommendations; it must not make automatic causal, validity, or SEM claims.

When only a research/business question is supplied, recommend questionnaire, interview, observation, existing-data connector, experiment, or mixed methods. The recommendation requires human acceptance before instrument design.

QuestionnaireSpecification: title, purpose, research questions, owner, locale and status
planned population, collection window and intended analyses
ordered stable item IDs, sections, branching and display randomization rules
consent/privacy reference and human-review/publish approval references
QuestionItem: item_id, wording, help text, response type, required flag and section/order
single choice, multiple choice, Likert/rating, numeric, text, date/time, matrix/grid, ranking or provider-supported equivalent
allowed values, labels, numeric coding, scale type, validation and skip/branch rules
construct_id, indicator role, reverse_coded flag and source/adaptation provenance
ConstructScale: construct_id, conceptual definition and indicator item IDs
scoring rule, reverse coding, minimum answered items and missingness rule
expected reliability/validity review and literature/source reference
ConsentPrivacyMetadata: purpose and lawful/ethical basis recorded by the study owner
consent text/version, participant information and withdrawal route
data classification, direct/indirect identifier inventory and minimization plan
access roles, retention/deletion dates, geography and onward-use restrictions
SamplingDesign: target population, sampling frame, inclusion/exclusion and recruitment channel
probability/non-probability method, strata, clusters, quotas and planned weights
sample-size rationale, expected response rate and nonresponse follow-up plan
experimental assignment fields only when a separate experiment is genuinely designed
ResponseProvenance: instrument_id/version, provider, provider form reference and export/synchronization time
stable pseudonymous respondent_id, provider response reference, started/submitted times and completion state
item-to-column map, source locale, collection wave, group/stratum/cluster and assignment references when applicable
raw-export digest and transformation lineage without storing provider access material
CollectionStatus: draft/published/paused/closed/frozen state and exact instrument version
invited, started, completed, partial and excluded counts
quota/strata progress, dropout points, last synchronization and provider warnings
collection target is planning context, never proof of representativeness or quality
BiasQualityDiagnostics: missingness by item/respondent/group and completion-time anomalies
duplicate/straight-line/low-variance attention indicators as review flags, not automatic fraud labels
coverage, selection and nonresponse diagnostics against the declared sampling frame
wording/order/branch exposure, common-method risk and mode effects
item-total behavior, internal consistency candidates and measurement-invariance prerequisites
all exclusions and derived scores retain reason, rule version and human-review status
AnalyticalDatasetHandoff: dataset_id, frozen snapshot time, instrument/version and row/column counts
response table reference plus sanitized field manifest and item-to-variable map
construct/indicator/scoring metadata, reverse-coded items and scale/measurement levels
missing-value semantics, respondent/group/design variables, weights/strata/clusters and provenance
consent/use restrictions, quality warnings, transformation lineage and production approval state

questionnaire_is_plausible_for: self-reported attitudes, perceptions, preferences, intentions, experiences or knowledge
standardized measurement across a defined population when participants can answer meaningfully
constructs with defensible indicators or a reviewed exploratory instrument goal
recommend_alternatives_when: the answer already exists in reliable administrative/transactional data
direct behavior or environmental observation is required instead of self-report
causal effect is the core question and treatment assignment is feasible
the topic, population, literacy/access constraints or risk require interviews, qualitative work or specialist ethics review
a questionnaire would impose disproportionate burden or cannot validly measure the construct
questionnaire_appropriateness_advisory.authority: The advisory produces a rationale and uncertainty, not an automatic methodological or ethics approval.

doe_and_bias_placement.questionnaire_design: Defines measurement: constructs, items, scales, wording, order, branching, response burden, mode, consent and validity evidence.
doe_and_bias_placement.sampling_design: Defines who can be observed: population, frame, recruitment, probability mechanism, strata/clusters/quotas, weights and nonresponse follow-up.
doe_and_bias_placement.experimental_design: Defines interventions and causal contrasts: treatments, controls, random assignment, blocking, factorial structure, blinding and outcome timing. It is not implied by distributing a questionnaire.
doe_and_bias_placement.randomization: Item/order randomization belongs to instrument administration and wording/order-bias control. Treatment randomization belongs to a separately approved experimental protocol.

bias_map.common_method: Questionnaire Design, measurement timing/source separation and analysis warnings
bias_map.wording_and_order: QuestionItem versions, section/order exposure and pretest evidence
bias_map.measurement_validity: ConstructScale evidence, pilot/EFA/CFA and invariance review
bias_map.causal_validity: Experimental Design, not ordinary survey collection

survey_collection_provider.principle: Google Forms is one adapter behind a generic Survey Collection Provider; provider-specific IDs and limitations remain in provenance rather than defining the domain contract.
operations: connect with explicit delegated user authorization and revoke
create/update draft from an immutable Questionnaire Specification version
render provider mapping and unsupported-feature warnings for human review
publish only with an exact human approval reference
read collection metadata/status and export response pages incrementally
pause/close/freeze collection through explicit user action
health, synchronization cursor, idempotency key and provider provenance
survey_collection_provider.google_forms_specific_boundary: A future connector should use documented Google APIs and least-privilege delegated access. It must never place account credentials or delegated access material in repository artifacts, logs, Learning Memory, or handoff metadata.

ku2a_sem_placement.location: SEM belongs in KU2A as a future advanced analytical family after dataset intake, profile, reviewed preparation and model setup. KU2D supplies instrument/sampling/provenance metadata but does not estimate SEM.
measurement_stage: indicator coding, reverse scoring and missing-data plan
CFA with factor loadings, residuals and correlated-error restrictions under human review
reliability and convergent/discriminant validity diagnostics such as omega/alpha, composite reliability, AVE and HTMT where appropriate
group/time measurement-invariance workflow when comparisons are intended
structural_stage: reviewed directional paths, covariances and control variables
direct, indirect/mediation and total effects with justified uncertainty estimation
moderation through reviewed interactions or multi-group models where appropriate
fit and residual diagnostics including chi-square context, CFI, TLI, RMSEA and SRMR
alternative-model and sensitivity warnings without claiming causal identification from cross-sectional association
prerequisites: versioned construct-to-item map and scale coding
sample-size/power or precision rationale appropriate to estimator/model complexity
ordinal versus continuous indicator declaration and estimator choice
missingness, nonnormality, clustering, weights and sampling-design metadata
instrument version, collection mode/wave, respondent/group IDs and provenance
human-reviewed model specification and interpretation boundary

minimum_shared_metadata_for_ku2a: instrument_id, instrument_version, study/research question and collection wave
stable item_id to dataset-column mapping and original wording/version
construct_id, indicator role, reverse_coded flag and reviewed scoring rule
response and scale types, value/label coding, ordered categories and missing-value meanings
stable pseudonymous respondent_id plus grouping, time, treatment/assignment fields when genuinely applicable
sampling frame/method, strata, clusters, quotas, weights and recruitment channel
provider/export provenance, collection window, transformation lineage and quality warnings
privacy_authorization_boundaries: Provider connection is explicit, revocable, least-privilege delegated access owned by the user/study; connection does not authorize form publication.
Human Publish Approve binds to an exact Questionnaire Specification and provider draft preview.
Respondent consent and study authorization are distinct from Google account connection and from KU2A analysis permission.
Collect only necessary identifiers; use study-scoped pseudonymous respondent IDs and separate re-identification material where required.
Enforce role-based access, retention/deletion, export audit, withdrawal/correction handling and purpose limitation.
Do not expose responses in GitHub, coordination records, Learning Memory, logs, public observation storage or future ML datasets by default.
Sensitive/high-risk studies require institutional ethics/privacy review outside automated KU2D approval.
